guidance: Mock policy: Ask the customer to use the bank's secure channel to block a lost or stolen credit card. A service agent must verify the account before discussing transactions. Do not promise reimbursement.
Mock policy: Record the transaction date, merchant and amount through a secure process. Route the dispute to a trained card specialist. Do not state that the charge will be reversed.
Mock policy: Ask a card specialist to review the payment posting date and fee details after account verification. Do not promise that a fee will be waived.
Mock policy: Direct the customer to a secure channel to report an unrecognized bank account transaction. An authorized agent must verify the account and investigate. Do not promise recovery of funds.
Mock policy: For login or account access problems, direct the customer to the bank's secure recovery process. Never ask for a password, PIN or one-time passcode in a complaint response.
Mock policy: After secure verification, an account specialist may check the deposit or transfer status and explain the next investigation step. Do not guarantee a completion time.
Mock policy: After secure verification, a servicing specialist should review the payment record and posting date. Do not confirm that an alleged error occurred before the review.
Mock policy: Direct questions about a mortgage statement, balance or escrow item to a servicing specialist for a record review. Do not quote an account-specific balance without verification.
Mock policy: Route a request for mortgage payment assistance to a trained servicing specialist to discuss available options after verification. Do not claim that an option has been approved.
